questions.prompt: You change Storage Insights' availability color threshold in a copied workbook. What changes?

options.explanation: Workbook formatting does not change service availability or create a rule.
A display threshold does not change a service guarantee.

options.text: An alert rule is automatically created with that threshold.
options.explanation: Workbook coloring and alert configuration are separate.
The workbook setting does not configure redundancy.

questions.prompt: You want Blob resource logs archived in Azure Storage. May the diagnostic setting target the same account it monitors?

options.explanation: Recursive logging is precisely the reason this is not supported.

options.text: No; use a different destination account.
options.explanation: This avoids logs describing their own writes.
A different container does not remove the same-account restriction.

options.text: Yes; use a CNAME for the account.
options.explanation: An alias still targets the same account.

questions.prompt: Do Storage Insights' platform metrics require installing AMA on a client VM?

options.text: Yes; every transaction metric is collected from that guest.
options.explanation: Platform storage metrics originate from the service.

options.text: Yes; AMA must be installed inside the storage account.
options.explanation: A storage account is not a VM guest for AMA installation.

options.text: No; platform metrics are collected by Azure.
options.explanation: Additional resource logs have their own collection configuration.

options.text: Yes; Dependency Agent supplies storage capacity.
options.explanation: That agent is not the platform storage metric source.
